create_evs_config: create EVS config from NemotronH_Nano_VL_V2 config with video pruning rate
build_nano_nemotron_vl_model: build a NemotronH_Nano_VL_V2 multimodal model with language and vision components
run_forward_multimodal: run forward pass to process image and video features through the language model
load_model_weights: load LLM, vision, and adapter weights into the NemotronH_Nano_VL_V2 model
extract_video_features: extract video features by projecting vision model embeddings into language model space
